```{r}
#| include: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(moderndive)
library(broom)
```

# Code for class: MarioKart example

```{r}
glimpse(mariokart) # from openintro package

mariokart <- mariokart |> 
  mutate(auction_pr = total_pr - ship_pr)

gg1 = mariokart |> ggplot(aes(x=auction_pr)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30, color="black", fill="gray")+ 
  theme_bw()+ 
  xlab("Auction price (USD)")


# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/mariokart_histogram.png",
       plot = gg1,
       width = 4,
       height = 3)

mariokart |> filter(auction_pr > 100) |> select(auction_pr, title)

mariokart2 <- mariokart |> 
	filter(auction_pr < 100)

gg2 <- mariokart2 |>
	ggplot(aes(x=auction_pr)) + 	
	geom_histogram(bins=20, color="black", fill="gray") +
  theme_bw()+
  xlab( "Auction price (USD)")

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/mariokart_histogram_outlierremov.png",
       plot = gg2,
       width = 5,
       height = 4)

gg3 = mariokart2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = duration, y =auction_pr)) +
  geom_point()+ 
  theme_bw()+ 
  labs(y="Auction price (USD)", x = "Auction length (days)")


# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/association_plot.png",
       plot = gg3,
       width = 6,
       height = 4)


gg4 <- mariokart2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = duration, y = total_pr)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)+ 
  theme_bw()+ 
  labs(y="Auction price (USD)", x = "Auction length (days)")

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/association_plot_plusline.png",
       plot = gg4,
       width = 6,
       height = 4)

# Model with only duration as predictor
model1 <- lm(auction_pr ~ duration, data = mariokart2)
model1 |> tidy()

# Get estimated coefficients
beta0_hat <- model1 |> tidy() |>
  filter(term == "(Intercept)") |>
  select(estimate) |>
  pull()

beta1_hat <- model1 |> tidy() |>
  filter(term == "duration") |>
  select(estimate) |>
  pull()

beta0_hat
beta1_hat


gg5 <- mariokart2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=cond, y=auction_pr)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+ 
  labs(y="Auction price (USD)", x = "Game condition")


# Save plot
gg5 <- ggsave(filename = "./Plots/boxplot_condition.png",
       plot = gg5,
       width = 4,
       height = 4)

mariokart2 |>
  group_by(cond) |>
  summarise(n=n())



# Model with only condition (binary) as predictor
model2 <- lm(auction_pr ~ cond, data = mariokart2)
model2 |> tidy()

mariokart2 |>
  group_by(cond) |>
  summarise(n=n(), 
            mean = mean(auction_pr))


gg6<- mariokart2 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = duration, y = auction_pr, color = cond)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Auction length (days)") +
  ylab("Auction price (USD)")+
  theme_bw()

# Save plot
gg6 <- ggsave(filename = "./Plots/duration_color_scatter.png",
       plot = gg6,
       width = 6,
       height = 4)

model3 <- lm(auction_pr ~ duration + cond, data = mariokart2)
model3 |> tidy()
gg7<-mariokart2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = duration, y = auction_pr, color=cond)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Auction length (days)") +
  ylab("Auction price (USD)")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_parallel_slopes(se=FALSE)

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/duration_color_scatter_line.png",
       plot = gg7,
       width = 6,
       height = 4)


model4 <- lm(auction_pr ~ duration * cond, data = mariokart2)
model4 |> tidy()

gg8<-mariokart2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = duration, y = total_pr, color=cond)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Auction length (days)") +
  ylab("Auction price (USD)")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)+
  theme_bw()

# Save plot
ggsave(filename = "./Plots/duration_color_int_scatter_line.png",
       plot = gg8,
       width = 6,
       height = 4)




```

```{r}
# Model comparisons

model1 |> glance() 
model2 |> glance() 
model3 |> glance() 
model4 |> glance() 

model1 |> glance() |> select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC)
model2 |> glance() |> select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC)
model3 |> glance() |> select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC)
model4 |> glance() |> select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC)

```
